pal:exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
pal:exercises.notes: Upper chest, triceps, front delts. Shoulder blades back and down; slight arch; lower the dumbbells under control; press up and slightly inward.

pal:exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
pal:exercises.notes: Lats and upper back. Brace the torso; pull toward the hip; do not twist or jerk.

pal:exercises.name: Pull-Up
pal:exercises.notes: Full controlled reps from a hang; do not kick.

pal:exercises.name: Lateral Raise
pal:exercises.notes: Side delts. Soft elbows; lead with the elbows; stop near shoulder height; no swinging.

pal:exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
pal:exercises.notes: Rear delts and upper back. Hinge forward; soft elbows; spread the dumbbells apart; do not shrug.

pal:exercises.name: Hammer Curl
pal:exercises.notes: Biceps, brachialis, forearms. Neutral grip; elbows stay near the torso; no swinging.

pal:exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
pal:exercises.notes: Hamstrings, glutes, back. Soft knees; push the hips backward; back neutral; feel the hamstring stretch.

pal:exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
pal:exercises.notes: Full stretch at the bottom; drive onto the toes; pause a second at the top; do not bounce.

pal:exercises.name: Walking Lunges
pal:exercises.notes: Long controlled steps; front knee follows the toes; keep the intensity easy.

pal:templates.name: Monday Push — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: 3 min general movement first — light cardio, arm circles, bodyweight squats. Not a warm-up set per exercise. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Chest, shoulders and quads. Three blocks, ~24 min of lifting, ~30 min door to door.

pal:templates.name: Tuesday Pull — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: 3 min general movement first — light cardio, arm circles, bodyweight squats. Not a warm-up set per exercise. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Back, biceps and posterior chain. Pull-ups first while you are freshest.

items.note: Broken up however you like across the three minutes.
A short flow, three or four poses. Hold what feels tight.

pal:templates.name: Wednesday Recovery — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: Active recovery, and the one day that is deliberately NOT dense — nothing here is paired and nothing is meant to be hard. Take as long as you like between pieces.

pal:templates.name: Thursday Push — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: 3 min general movement first — light cardio, arm circles, bodyweight squats. Not a warm-up set per exercise. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Shoulder priority and unilateral legs. The rope at the end is a finisher, not a block — it is not paired with anything.

pal:templates.name: Friday Pull — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: 3 min general movement first — light cardio, arm circles, bodyweight squats. Not a warm-up set per exercise. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Lats, arms and posterior chain. Chin-ups first, for the same reason pull-ups go first on Tuesday.

items.note: Can be done during the wall sit rather than after it.
Front, lateral, rear — 12–15 each, no rest between the three.

pal:templates.name: Saturday Shoulders — HIGH
pal:templates.notes: 3 min general movement first — light cardio, arm circles, bodyweight squats. Not a warm-up set per exercise. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Shoulders, core and calves — the accessories that carry the week. Block 1 can genuinely be done at the same time: hold the wall sit and fly with the dumbbells while you are down there.

pal:templates.name: Monday Push — MID
pal:templates.notes: 2 min general movement first. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Two blocks instead of three, ~20 min. This is not half a workout — it is the version of Monday that fits the day you actually have.

pal:templates.name: Tuesday Pull — MID
pal:templates.notes: 2 min general movement first. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. The two blocks that carry the most back volume. Arms come out first because the pulling already works them.

items.note: A few stretches for whatever time is left.

pal:templates.name: Wednesday Recovery — MID
pal:templates.notes: Active recovery. Not paired, not dense, not meant to be hard.

pal:templates.name: Thursday Push — MID
pal:templates.notes: 2 min general movement first. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Shoulders and unilateral legs, without the rope finisher.

pal:templates.name: Friday Pull — MID
pal:templates.notes: 2 min general movement first. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Lats and posterior chain. Direct arm work comes out first — the rows and chin-ups already cover it.

items.note: Can be done during the wall sit rather than after it.
Front, lateral, rear — 12–15 each, no rest between the three.

pal:templates.name: Saturday Shoulders — MID
pal:templates.notes: 2 min general movement first. Each block is a pair: set A, straight into set B, then rest 75 sec. The rest goes AFTER the pair, never between the two — that is the whole time saving. Repeat for every set, then move to the next block. Shoulders and calves. Block 1 can be done simultaneously — fly while you hold the wall sit.

pal:templates.name: Monday Push — LOW
pal:templates.notes: One block, ~10 min. Set A, straight into set B, rest 75 sec, repeat. Two sets finishes this — do the third only if it is there. Zero is the only real failure state.

pal:templates.name: Tuesday Pull — LOW
pal:templates.notes: One block, ~10 min. Set A, straight into set B, rest 75 sec, repeat. Two sets finishes this; three if it is there.

pal:templates.name: Wednesday Recovery — LOW
pal:templates.notes: The walk on its own still counts. Ten minutes, easy, and the day is done.

pal:templates.name: Thursday Push — LOW
pal:templates.notes: One block, ~10 min. Set A, straight into set B, rest 75 sec, repeat. Two sets finishes this; three if it is there.

pal:templates.name: Friday Pull — LOW
pal:templates.notes: One block, ~10 min. Set A, straight into set B, rest 75 sec, repeat. Two sets finishes this; three if it is there.

items.note: Can be done during the wall sit rather than after it.

pal:templates.name: Saturday Shoulders — LOW
pal:templates.notes: One block, ~10 min, and both halves can be done at once — hold the wall sit and fly with the dumbbells while you are down there.

pal:templates.name: Sunday — Rest
pal:templates.notes: Nothing required. Taking this keeps the streak — it does not break it.
